Do not copy the reference setting, background, outfit, pose, lighting, camera angle, or props unless the creator explicitly asks for those exact elements. Keep medium-close creator framing with the full face, full head, natural hair top, and clean breathing room above the hair. Keep the creator large in frame with face, upper body, torso, bust, waist, and hip angle as the main visual anchors; environment remains secondary. Preserve same natural sun-kissed skin tone, same recognizable body structure, same hair worn down naturally, and same creator identity. Use emotionally alive expression language: warm eye contact, teasing smile, playful confidence, private gaze, relaxed smirk, or subtle parted lips. Premium concepts should feel sensual, teasing, private, varied, paid-content-ready, realistic, candid, and phone-camera creator-authentic while avoiding blank model stare, stiff catalog posing, scenery-first composition, cropped forehead, missing hair top, and hardcore sexual action unless the creator explicitly selected an explicit-ready lane.
prompt_metadata.premium_clothing_guidance: When the creator asks for clothing or wardrobe, preserve it as mandatory unless they explicitly ask for nude/topless/no clothing. Broad lingerie concepts should produce varied lingerie types, fabrics, colors, and styling instead of repeating one black-lace look. Mild casual ideas should be upgraded into premium with non-explicit visual hooks such as fitted fabric, low neckline, robe slipping off shoulder, strap adjustment, legs emphasized, hip curve, waist curve, tiny shorts, bralette, stockings, heels, wet fabric, or private fantasy tension while keeping garments visibly worn when specified.
